annotations.title: Name Check (is a business name free?)

description: Business and startup name availability: .com .io .ai .co .app .dev domains, GitHub, npm, Bluesky and YouTube handles, links for X and LinkedIn, US trademark (USPTO) and WIPO search links, and a verdict. Use when a founder asks whether a business, startup, product or app name is available, or before registering a domain or handles. Pass name (e.g. Acme Labs; spaces are removed for domains). Returns verdict (strong, workable, risky), verdictText, score 0-100, domains[] {domain, status free/taken/unknown, registeredAt, registrar, buyUrl}, handles[] {platform, handle, status, url, how checked/manual}, trademark {usptoUrl, wipoUrl, note} and nextSteps[]. Domains use RDAP plus DNS; registry premium names can show as free. For Instagram, TikTok and a Google check for businesses already using the name, use name_check_report; for new name ideas, name_check_ideas. Price: $0.02 per call from Exepal credit; not charged if the call fails. Larger or cheaper variants, listed when the server URL ends in ?tools=all: name_check_report (adds Instagram, TikTok, more domains and a Google check for businesses using the name, $0.25); name_check_ideas (10 checked startup names for an idea, $0.50).
